verdict.rationale: Hosted cloud inference is a fair axis for a local LLM runner, but no evidence in the pack documents a hosted cloud tier or running models without downloading them. All model docs describe downloading and running locally. llmster on 'cloud instances' is self-hosted on the user's own machines, not a hosted tier. The Bionic line about running 'frontier open models' for demanding tasks never says those models run on hosted infrastructure, so it does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient
